column1: # sweep-2x2-ops-version
# Row config for corpus/sweep_2x2.py (HANDOFF-§3-style {semantic,hand} x {OFF,ON} sweep).
# kind: full2x2 = distinct hand LLK exists (four cells); semantic = 2x2 collapses to
# sem OFF/ON; pinpair = paired gen-vs-hand A/B at the row's pin_flags (no OFF/ON legs;
# cells keep the baseline's native selectors, e.g. generated/handwritten_replay);
# skip = machine-readable absent row (no runnable node on this pin) —
# recorded in every scoreboard, never silent.
# marker: profiler marker row used as the metric zone. KERNEL is mandatory for
# fire-and-forget replay-launch shapes (BODY is invalid there, HANDOFF §1 metric
# caveat); TILE_LOOP for eltwise perf suites. cycles/tile = mean(<metric>)/tile_cnt.
# craq_archs: comma list of simulator legs run before any silicon (bh required).
# v2 columns: metric (default MATH_ISOLATE), per_tile (default 1; 0 = absolute scoped
# cycles), issue_slot_lb (HANDOFF §1 issue-slot sanity check: BODY-family readings on
# macro-launch shapes must be >= this payload issue-slot lower bound, else
# INVALID_MARKER and the KERNEL marker is required), pin_flags (pinpair rows:
# the exact TT_LLK_EXTRA_COMPILER_OPTIONS of the pinned pair), extra_env
# (semicolon list of K=V set for every leg of the row).
# issue_slot_lb is REQUIRED on macro-launch rows (enforcement layer, ledger item 10):
# the classify phase disassembles every leg; a row whose ON binary contains
# SFPLOADMACRO launches or ON-only fire-and-forget ttreplay launches with an EMPTY
# issue_slot_lb is RED (never a silent no-op).  UNITS: the bound is compared against
# the row's RECORDED cell values — for marker=TILE_LOOP rows the post CSV is already
# per-tile and sweep_2x2.py divides by tile_cnt again (baseline header E4), so a
# TILE_LOOP row's lb = true per-tile issue-slot bound / tile_cnt; non-TILE_LOOP
# markers carry no extra division.  Each row's note records the raw arithmetic
# (launches x payload slots + config words per tile) and the PASS/FAIL evidence.
# Node ids are exact pytest node ids at tt-metal 55ce75be (Lane D classify/*/node.txt);
# reduce-sdpa node ids from the bb56f1d7797 gate-fix promotion A/B (run-promo-silicon.sh).
